storage: Ripe tomatoes keep at room temperature for a few days; the fridge slows spoilage but dulls the flavour. Keep cut tomato in a closed box in the fridge for 1 to 2 days.
looksLike: A round, smooth red fruit, juicy inside with seeds in jelly-like pulp. Indian shops sell "desi" or "local" (smaller, tangier, softer) and "hybrid" (firmer, more uniform) types.
howToPick: Firm but slightly yielding, evenly red, glossy, with a fresh tomato smell. Avoid split skin, soft wet patches or green shoulders (unripe) unless you want tangy firm tomato.
shelfLife: Ripe tomatoes keep about 3 to 5 days on the counter (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 30 g per serving (2 tbsp, finely chopped)
